chunks: And it is inscribed in the Book.
ai.seo_question: What happens to every city before the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the universality of divine justice, where 'every city' encompasses all human settlements regardless of their prominence, affirming that destruction or severe punishment is a preordained reality inscribed in the Preserved Tablet (Al-Kitab). It highlights the certainty of Allah's retribution against civilizations that persist in sin, serving as a warning that no community is exempt from the consequences of its collective moral decay.
